SEN.note: The CNRM law is said to respond to disinformation and AI in general terms; no AI harm rule or promulgation is stated.
No government use of AI stated.
No AI built or hosted in the country stated.

facts.fact: The Senegalese Union of Information and Communication Professionals (SYNPICS) and the Senegalese Council of Broadcasters and Press Editors (CDEPS) publicly criticised the law creating the National Media Regulatory Council, adopted 3 March 2026, as a threat to press freedom, per an MFWA statement of 31 March 2026.
